olga_csm: Kickoff for Kepler Partners onboarding — assigning stakeholders & success criteria. 30-day pilot goal: live /api inference + embeddings-backed search in prod. Draft timeline below. @lucas_pm @sam_engineer @priya_enable please confirm owners.

maya_success: Quick Q — do they require SAML/Okta or just API keys for the pilot?

sam_engineer: They confirmed SAML via Okta in intake. We'll need the private-deploy checklist + network ACL review. I can own SAML integration and infra ticket.

lucas_pm: I'll own product acceptance criteria. Proposed success metrics: p50 latency < 120ms, p95 < 450ms on pilot traffic; embedding recall >= 0.78 on sample dataset; zero critical errors for 72h. I'll draft acceptance tests.

priya_enable: I'll run two enablement sessions: developer sandbox walkthrough (week 1) and production runbook + incident playbook (week 3). Also will prepare sample prompts and integration examples.

olga_csm: Noted. Main renewal risk: month-9 renewal if throughput or cost is unclear. Mitigation suggestions: dedicated capacity trial + short SLA on QPS for pilot, and a cost-forecast runbook. @sam_engineer can we provision a small dedicated pool for 30d?

sam_engineer: Yes. Filing infra request today. Example request we send to infra-ops:

```
team: customer-success
customer: kepler-partners
env: pilot
GPUs: 2xA10G
duration: 30d
expected_qps: 8
priority: pilot
```

I'll attach the SAML plan and timeline in the infra ticket.

maya_success: :thumbsup: I'll schedule stakeholder intro for Tue 10:00 PT and send the stakeholder roster. calendar-bot: please add the room and the Kepler admin.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Kepler Partners: Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 10:00 PT • Attendees: olga_csm, maya_success, lucas_pm, sam_engineer, priya_enable • Link: https://calendar.app/kepler-kickoff

olga_csm: Action items recap: 1) sam_engineer — infra ticket + SAML details (48h) 2) lucas_pm — draft acceptance tests & perf targets (EOW) 3) priya_enable — enablement slides + sample prompts (next Wed) 4) maya_success — stakeholder roster + client comms (tomorrow). I'll consolidate into a short playbook and share here.

lucas_pm: Got it. I'll include eval prompt set and the metric thresholds; will mark any gating regressions that should block launch.

maya_success: Also adding cadence: weekly 30-min syncs during pilot, ad-hoc deep dives for any regressions, and an NPS check at day 21. Logging initial risks: SAML timing, network ACL approvals, model quality regressions, and cost variance.

olga_csm: Perfect. I'll post the one-page playbook here after the calendar invite goes out. Thanks team — excited to get Kepler into pilot. :sparkles:
